S/RES/2824 (2026) · 2026-06-25

UN Security Council Resolution 2824 (2026)

Extension of the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF) until 31 Dec. 2026

Ukraine and fragmentation · Middle East

Unanimous
Yes 15No 0Abstained 0
Ceasefires

Official document (PDF) · Draft S/2026/514 · Meeting record S/PV.10183

United Nations S/RES/2824 (2026) Security Council Distr.: General 25 June 2026 Resolution 2824 (2026) Adopted by the Security Council at its 10183rd meeting , on 25 June 2026 The Security Council , Reaffirming all prior resolutions pertaining to the mandate of UNDOF, most recently resolution 2811 (2025) , Expressing concern at all violations of the Disengagement of Forces Agreement between Israel and the Syrian Arab Republic,

1. Calls upon the parties concerned to implement immediately its resolution 338 (1973) of 22 October 1973;

2. Stresses the obligation on both parties to scrupulously and fully respect the terms of the 1974 Disengagement of Forces Agreement, calls on the parties to exercise maximum restraint and prevent any breaches of the ceasefire and the area of separation, encourages the parties to take full advantage of UNDOF’s liaison function regularly to address issues of mutual concern, as appropriate, and to maintain their liaison with UNDOF to prevent any escalation of the situation across the ceasefire line, as well as to support the enhancement of the UNDOF liaison function, and underscores that there should be no military activity of any kind in the area of separation;

3. Decides to renew the mandate of UNDOF for a period of six months, that is, until 31 December 2026, and requests the Secretary-General to ensure that UNDOF has the required capacity and resources to fulfil the mandate in a safe and secure way;

4. Requests the Secretary-General to report every 90 days on developments in the situation and the measures taken to implement resolution 338 (1973) ;

5. Decides to remain actively seized of the matter.
